summary: Preserve the client-v0 schema's integer domains in Rust client models

schema.detail: The committed wire and storage schemas are unchanged.

rules.detail: No admission or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Rust client fields whose schema domain exceeds u32/i32 storage now use u64/i64; schema-signed fields no longer use unsigned storage. Existing wire payloads are unchanged. Rust consumers must adapt typed assignments and use checked conversion at narrower UI or terminal APIs.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; older Rust models may reject the wider wire values they previously could not represent.
